reason: A Zhihu research and monitoring dashboard that provides search, feeds, favorites, content tracking, local organization, and native agent tools through the Zhihu Open Platform.

summaries.zh: 通过知乎开放平台提供热榜、搜索、关注动态、收藏夹和帖子追踪，并支持在智能体对话中调用相关工具。
summaries.en: Provides Zhihu hot lists, search, feeds, favorites, and post tracking through the Zhihu Open Platform, with related tools available in agent conversations.

capabilities: Searches and retrieves Zhihu content through zhihu-cli and Zhihu Open Platform APIs
Displays feeds, favorites, tracked posts, and hot lists in a dashboard
Runs scheduled tracking checks and can issue system notifications
Registers agent tools for Zhihu search, feeds, favorites, and answer retrieval
Stores user-configured Access Secret and local workspace data in browser storage
